text: The world feels peculiarly tilted here, as if my own equilibrium is a little uncertain in this clean, modern space. Everything is carefully ordered, yet the slant gives a sense of unsettled anticipation. Entering the exhibit area and seeing "R+D" boldly on the wall, I feel a curiosity rise in me, mingling with slight disorientation. I am compelled to orient myself both physically and intellectually, ready to absorb what this innovative environment is eager to present. It is a place for questioning, exploring, and perhaps being transformed by new ideas.
